cultures.title: Babylonian Astronomy

cultures.image_prompt: Ancient cuneiform tablet with a golden glow, showing orbital diagrams of Jupiter, hyper-realistic, dark aesthetic, neon blue accents.

cultures.title: Surya Siddhanta

cultures.title: Mayan Calendrics

cultures.title: Ptolemaic System
